substantive_reconstruction.complements: With r=|c|, delta=1-r^2>0, u=(psi-conj(c)phi)/sqrt(delta), v=(phi-c psi)/sqrt(delta), direct sesquilinear expansion gives ||u||=||v||=1, <phi|u>=<psi|v>=0, <psi|u>=<phi|v>=sqrt(delta), and <u|v>=-c. No real-overlap gauge is used.
substantive_reconstruction.impossibility: For PSD E, a zero expectation means E annihilates the vector because E has a positive square root. On the fixed two-space, self-adjointness makes E_psi=a|u><u|, E_phi=b|v><v|. Completeness in psi and phi forces a=b=1/delta. Its trace2/delta exceeds trace I=2 for every0<r<1, a contradiction. The candidate's independent alternate proof also works: E_psi psi=psi, E_psi phi=0 imply c=<E_psi psi|phi>=<psi|E_psi phi>=0 by self-adjointness.
substantive_reconstruction.gram_and_effect_spectra: For F with columns(u,v), G=F^dagger F has matrix[[1,-c],[-conj(c),1]], characteristic polynomial(1-lambda)^2-r^2 and eigenvalues1+r,1-r. Both are positive, so F is invertible; F F^dagger has the same spectrum (e.g. F G F^-1=F F^dagger). Hence S=(F F^dagger)/(1+r) has eigenvalues1,(1-r)/(1+r), and I-S has0,2r/(1+r). This proves positivity of the inconclusive effect, not just completeness by definition.
substantive_reconstruction.probabilities_and_endpoints: Wrong-label probabilities vanish by the two orthogonality identities. Correct probability is delta/(1+r)=1-r and inconclusive probability r for either state. At r=0 the states are orthogonal and the two complementary projectors suffice; at r=1 the complement formulas are undefined and that case is excluded. Normalized states and delta>0 force the specified span to be exactly two-dimensional, so no empty-space or singular-F case was omitted.
substantive_reconstruction.complex_discriminator: For psi=e0 and phi=(i/2)e0+(sqrt(3)/2)e1, c=i/2, u=(sqrt(3)/2)e0+(i/2)e1 and v=e1. Thus <u|v>=-i/2, not a real-overlap substitution. The conclusive sum eigenvalues are1 and1/3, P_? eigenvalues0 and2/3, and each correct outcome has probability1/2. Forced conclusive-only weights4/3 would give trace8/3>2. This directly discriminates the repaired conjugation from the original expression.
